hints.title: Adjacent Pairs
hints.text: An array of length n possesses exactly n - 1 adjacent transitions.

hints.title: Combination Selection
hints.text: Choose k matching adjacent positions out of n - 1 in C(n - 1, k) ways.

hints.title: Block Assignment
hints.text: Assign the first element in m ways, then each of the remaining n - 1 - k distinct transitions has m - 1 options.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputes factorials up to n and applies modular exponentiation in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive state transition table exceeds memory and time bounds for n up to 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) factorial and inverse factorial arrays enable O(1) combinations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives closed-form formula C(n - 1, k) * m * (m - 1)^(n - 1 - k) mod (10^9 + 7).
